text: Ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko nn ɓe senndaali ɗum, ko ɓen woni siforɓe goonguugol. Sahimbinaaɓe ɓen ka Joomi mun, hino woodani ɓen mbarjaari maɓɓe maranaaɓe ndi ɓen e annoora ndaygiroyaɗo yeeso e ñaame maɓɓe Ñalnde Darngal. Ɓen non yedduɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe woni e fennugol Aayeeje jippinaaɗe ɗen e Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, ko ɓen woni yimɓe Jahiimi ngen. Ɓe naatoyat e magge Ñalnde Darngal, ko ɓe luttata poomaa.
